Chapter 872: Chapter 14: You Are All Surrounded By Me (Please Subscribe)

Chapter 872: Chapter 14: You Are All Surrounded by Me (Please Subscribe)

Xuanyuan You’s war plan was quite comprehensive, but what Lin Yuan was primarily interested in was not the plan itself.

But the peak powers and individual strong beings of other pinnacle races, as adversaries of the Human Civilization Alliance.

“Every member of the Robber Clan requires twenty of our same-level evolvers just to restrain them?” Lin Yuan saw the battle plan against the Robber Clan.

Even though Lin Yuan had heard of the fearsomeness of this race, he was still somewhat astonished.

From Xuanyuan You’s war plan, Lin Yuan saw no intention of wanting to defeat the opponent.

The entire purpose was to hold back the Robber Clan powerhouses.

“The Robber Clan is terrifying.”

Xuanyuan You sighed, “Had their challenge to ultimate not been so astoundingly difficult, this universe might well have been under the Robber Clan’s control.”

To strike at the ultimate from the Eleventh Level, one must break free from the bonds of the river of time.

For a normal Eleventh Level to escape the river of time, the difficulty is ten, then for the Robber Clan it is a hundred, a thousand.

The moment a Robber Clan member challenges the ultimate, backlash from the entire universe descends without giving them any chance to adapt or react.

This is also why there are currently only two ultimate beings at the Twelfth Level among the Robber Clan.

Aside from their sparse population, their success rate of reaching the ultimate is pitifully low.

“There’s nothing wrong with the war plan.”

Lin Yuan looked towards Xuanyuan You and spoke: “However, there’s no need to arrange for me.”

In Xuanyuan You’s war plan, there were also arrangements for Lin Yuan, such as dealing with the strongest Eleventh Level of some pinnacle race powers?

“Not arrange for the Galaxy Master?”

Xuanyuan You was somewhat puzzled in his heart but proceeded anyway, “Alright.”

Even though this would greatly increase the pressure on other Eleventh Level evolvers from human civilization.

But Xuanyuan You had no intention of questioning Lin Yuan’s orders.

“Alright.”

“Once the full-scale war begins, just contact me directly.”

“Handle other matters on your own.”

Lin Yuan gestured, moving all the Eleventh Level Perfected Evolvers outside the control room like Xuanyuan You.

…

“Chaos Rule…”

While comprehending the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule and many other rules, Lin Yuan was also contemplating how to derive the Chaos Rule.

After stepping into the Eleventh Level, Lin Yuan’s clarity of rule comprehension as well as his Against-Heaven’s Understanding had both significantly improved.

But regarding the Chaos Rule, he still found no direction.

All things in the world originate from chaos, but what exactly is chaos, and how can one comprehend the Chaos Rule? Lin Yuan felt bewildered.

Xuanhuang and the Moyu Tower Master had both derived the Chaos Rule, and their explanation for deriving the Chaos Rule was that they had accumulated enough foundation, and then it came naturally.

However, it’s unclear just how much foundation must be accumulated for it to be enough.

Both Xuanhuang and the Moyu Tower Master are Chaos Realm powerhouses, if the required foundation here pertains to the bounds of the Chaos Realm, then Lin Yuan is destined not to comprehend the Chaos Rule at the Eleventh Level.

Even as strong as Xuanhuang and the Moyu Tower Master, neither had the experience of deriving the Chaos Rule at the Eleventh Level.

“Take it slow.”

“I’m not in a hurry.”

“Worst case, I’ll spend more time at the Eleventh Level.”

“Without certainty, I definitely won’t challenge the ultimate.”

Lin Yuan’s thoughts converged, and with his current strength of mind and will, he could easily live until the end of the Cosmic Era.

Mere centuries, even counting all the time traveling through worlds, meant Lin Yuan had only lived through a few thousand years, an insignificant speck compared to a complete Cosmic Era.

Therefore, Lin Yuan still had plenty of time to slowly contemplate.

…

“Martial Tao Eleventh Tier?”

Lin Yuan devoted a part of his mind, attempting to create a complete First Tier Chapter of the Martial Tao.

This was also a review and summary of his own path, creating the Martial Tao Eleventh Tier Chapter wasn’t just about advancing the evolution pathway of Martial Tao to the Eleventh Tier.

It’s about reflecting on the journey thus far.

Only by doing so could he grasp the present to better foresee his future.

…

Beyond the super-large battlefield.

Numerous ultimate beings at the Twelfth Level observed casually.

“Xia Qin, tell me the truth, is that Galaxy Master the same as the human Xueyu?” A supreme being from the Star Alliance asked the supreme being Xia Qin through telepathy.

Although this guess was incredible.

For example, when that White Paper descended into this universe, the Galaxy Master was only at the Tenth Layer.

Inside the Two-dimensional World, all extraordinary powers were suppressed, and theoretically, the Tenth Layer and Eleventh Layer started from the same point.

But it was only the same starting point, as time went on, the one with the higher life level grew at a much faster pace than those at lower levels.

The Galaxy Master was merely at the Tenth Layer, and even if he possessed treasures from human civilization that could break free from the suppression of the two-dimensional world.

But the realm and life level of the Galaxy Master were set, and no matter how powerful the treasures, one needed sufficient strength to activate them.

The Galaxy Master initially was but at the Tenth Layer, how could he possibly overpower the Four Divine Kings and other legends of the Eleventh Layer Perfected being? Furthermore, the Four Divine Kings also brought their strongest weapons suited for themselves.

However.

Based on the current strength displayed by the Galaxy Master, he equaled the strongest Eleventh Layer of the major peak races upon first entering the Eleventh Layer.

Additionally, when that White Paper descended, the Galaxy Master also fell into it.

And Xueyu and the Galaxy Master had never appeared at the same time and place.

As well as, after White Paper exited the universe, the Galaxy Master quickly ascended to the Eleventh Layer and so on.

Logically, after the fundamental loss from the Two-dimensional World, the Galaxy Master should have been affected even with human civilization’s compensation, so how could he easily step into the Eleventh Layer?
